scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag as requested.
Confirmed that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Went to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully; the confirmation states that order TS-5215 is in and €17.90 was charged.
